leadText: Theresa Buchheister is a non-binary voice actor and former voice director for the English-language dub of by DuArt Film & Video. They joined the series in 2015, succeeding the previous voice director, Tom Wayland. They left DuArt in January 2016, and was succeeded as voice director by Lisa Ortiz.
